## Research Integrity Checklist
- [ ] **No Fabricated Data:** Does NOT introduce fabricated benchmark results, synthetic accuracy curves, or fake citation metrics.
- [ ] **Empirical Grounding:** Clearly labels existing research evidence vs. project experimental results.
- [ ] **Scoping Adherence:** Preserves the core research focus (task-specific trust under uncertainty vs. reputation-only).
- [ ] **Reproducibility:** If introducing simulation changes, includes deterministic seed controls.
